mapper.select: SELECT fsr.id, fsr.stealerId AS stealerId, fsr.plantRecordId AS plantRecordId, fsr.cropId AS cropId, fsr.stolenTime AS stolenTime, fsr.coinGained AS coinGained, u.userName AS stealerNickname, u.userAvatar AS stealerAvatar, fc.name AS cropName FROM farm_steal_record fsr LEFT JOIN farm_user fu ON fsr.stealerId = fu.id LEFT JOIN user u ON fu.userId = u.id AND u.isDelete = 0 LEFT JOIN farm_crop fc ON fsr.cropId = fc.id WHERE fsr.ownerId = #{ownerId} ORDER BY fsr.stolenTime DESC
